scope: All twelve scoped research profiles concluded. Positive results are research qualification, not production integration or release qualification. The 27 permanent source closures and 32 older inconclusive findings remain separate.

results.title: Make streaming representation choices aware of complete-plan feasibility
results.measurement: 1.012× cost versus the fair selective-owner baseline; 14/31 pairs faster. No declared 5% benefit.
results.scope: 24 SDR VP8/VP9 segments, selected PCM/cues, rollback, cancellation and seeks; research controller, not shipping HLS/DASH.
results.next_action: Retain selective track ownership and complete-plan validation as prototype correctness findings. Reopen prefilter optimization on a workload with demonstrated fallback cost or plan-feasibility variability; productionHLS/HDR remains unqualified.

results.title: Reduce video frame rate before decoding
results.measurement: 0.808× full-job cost; all 7 pairs faster (19.25% median saving).
results.scope: 720p closed-GOP H264; 107 of 240 frames retained with exact pixels and original PTS. Not arbitrary constant-frame-rate conversion.
results.next_action: Integrate an explicit opt-in policy only for identified nonreference pictures; rerun native/WebCodecs/audio synchronization and other reference structures before broader use.

results.title: Frame-accurate video editing with only local re-encoding
results.measurement: 0.657× full-job cost; all 7 pairs faster (34.29% median saving).
results.scope: Uniform lossless H264: 46 edge frames re-encoded and 60 interior frames copied. Mixed lossy/lossless splice failed and is excluded.
results.next_action: Implement eligibility validation for uniform lossless profile; investigate mixed-profile splice divergence before any claim for arbitrary lossy sources, Bframes, openGOP or audio.

results.title: Play texture-native video without a conventional video decoder
results.measurement: 0.839× full-job cost; all 9 pairs faster; 8× smaller texture upload/storage.
results.scope: 32-frame Hap/BC1 profile, visible WebGPU canvas. RGB error at most one level, exact alpha; strict bit-exact profile failed.
results.next_action: Add container/format eligibility and fidelitypolicy before integration; qualify Snappy, other BC modes, dimensions, audio sync and realworldlong streams separately. Never advertise strict CPUdecode bitexactness.

results.title: Preserve floating-point audio through an integer-only codec
results.scope: 96,000 finite Float32 samples preserved and rendered exactly. Codec payload smaller, but native float WAV already works; no all-format claim.
results.next_action: Reopen if an integer-only transport is mandatory and bandwidth/storage benefit offsets custom reconstruction; qualify streaming, rate/layout variation and special floats separately.

results.title: Reconstruct unsupported visual properties from ordinary video streams
results.measurement: Alpha capability passed; prepared first-frame API job 0.242× tested correct native load/seek baseline.
results.scope: Three 32×32 frames, exact alpha, bounded premultiplied RGB, actual canvas and decoder lifecycle controls. Not a general playback or physical-display speedup; prefer suitable native alpha.
results.next_action: Use only for destinations needing explicit reconstructedalpha. Prefer existing native transparency whenit meetsoutputneeds. Measure equivalentpresented largercontinuousworkloads before claiming playback speedup.

results.title: Move part of a software video decoder onto the GPU
results.measurement: GPU slower in every larger-profile pair: cold 1.888–2.079×, reused device 1.656–1.818×.
results.scope: Actual MPEG2 entropy parsing included; 256×256 and 512×512, 33 pictures each, exact FFmpeg oracle. Browser startup excluded from both paths.
results.next_action: Stop the measured DC-only-I/integer-motion-P CPU-visible-output profile. Reopen for materially different faithful codec work, kernels or GPU-resident output contract that passes independent all-picture correctness and a matched end-to-end cost gate; do not extrapolate this result to arbitrary codecs or production routing.

results.title: Keep decoded video on the native overlay/display path
results.measurement: Final A/V CPU median 0.838×; 8/9 pairs faster, worst 1.109×. Failed the predeclared every-pair-faster gate.
results.scope: Native CALayer and all 73 source IDs measured at WindowServer; A/V cue and UI lifecycle checks passed. Not proof of hardware-plane promotion, photons, energy or physical speaker latency.
results.next_action: Reopen with an independently predeclared longer/representative confirmatory cost study; keep all appearance, actualsource delivery and audio-engine alignment controls. Do not change automaticrouting from this result.

results.title: Entropy-only transcoding
results.measurement: 0.824× complete-job cost; all 8 pairs faster (17.58% median saving).
results.scope: CABAC to CAVLC syntax translation; 78 independently decoded pictures exact across four progressive 8-bit 4:2:0 I/P profiles. No browser-tier claim.
results.next_action: Retain as a qualified restricted research operation. Production integration requires explicit admission checks and broader decoder/content/browser validation; only extend codec tools with new exact syntax and picture oracles.

results.title: Sidecars that let decoding start halfway through an entropy-coded slice
results.measurement: 1.477× complete-job cost; checkpoint records 5.55 MB versus 63.4 KB source.
results.scope: Fresh-process complete CABAC state restoration and full independent picture reconstruction. Prefix reconstruction costs included; not a standalone DPB capsule.
results.next_action: Stop the measured JSON/full-prefix-syntax profile. Reopen only for a compact complete-state representation or real repeated partial-entropy workload that can beat full decoding after charging preparation, retained references, serialization and complete-picture correctness.

results.title: Make custom presentation aware of display cadence
results.measurement: 0.103% median improvement in primary p95 phase error; required 15%.
results.scope: Actual WindowServer display timestamps and identifying source pixels, not predicted Chrome feedback. Six normal trials retained all 72 frames.
results.next_action: Reopen for a materially different phase policy, source/display cadence, or presentation owner with a fresh predeclared primary gate. Production retained/mpv and audio integration require their own independent correctness and cost tests.

results.title: Preserve hardware-overlay eligibility through subtitle and UI composition
results.measurement: Final A/V CPU median 0.838×; 8/9 pairs faster. Same shared robustness failure as R101.
results.scope: Matched captions, controls, scrolling, resizing, fullscreen and multivideo checks. Native-surface eligibility only; hardware promotion and system energy remain unqualified.
results.next_action: Reopen with an independently predeclared longer/representative confirmatory cost study; keep all appearance, actualsource delivery and audio-engine alignment controls. Do not change automaticrouting from this result.
